label: Diagram 7
caption: Diagram 7 Typical floors exposed from below
description: The image is a simple line drawing titled "Diagram 7 Typical floors exposed from below" in a pale green header band. It shows the cross-section outline of a building resting on a horizontal ground line. The left wall rises vertically, then an inclined roof line climbs to a peak and descends to a lower horizontal roof section, which ends in a vertical wall on the right. Inside this outline stand two structures on the ground line. On the left is a narrow rectangle, labelled "Passageway" to its left, with a thick black horizontal line capping its top. On the right is a wider rectangle, labelled "Parking area" within it, also capped by a thick black horizontal line. Centred above and between these two structures is the text "Exposed floors", from which two thin arrows extend downwards and outwards: the left arrow points to the thick black top of the passageway rectangle, and the right arrow points to the thick black top of the parking area rectangle.
